description: QueryDef parameter round trip, Currency, DateTime, Bit and Decimal: the same shape for each r-wire cell of FCurr, FDate, FBool and FDec (Currency limits, rounding and overflow; Date extremes, fractions, NaN and infinity; Boolean tags and texts; Decimal strings of 1 to 29 digits and other tags). Asks whether PARAMETERS accepts Decimal, the Parameter read-back and the V field tag and exact value.

args.text: PARAMETERS pV Currency; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
PARAMETERS pV DateTime; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
PARAMETERS pV Bit; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
PARAMETERS pV Decimal; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
